findings.label: Stale cover reference on URL unreachability
findings.description: If an image URL becomes unreachable between frontend validation and backend save, the cover reference is saved but the URL may fail to load later. Mitigated by fallback display logic and acceptable for portfolio context.

findings.label: Race condition on concurrent image removal
findings.description: Two simultaneous edits removing the same image cause concurrent fs.unlinkSync() calls. The second fails silently (error caught). Acceptable for infrequent portfolio edits with graceful error handling.
